payload.text: NEXT (P0, hv decisions 39 to 45), in order. (1) devbin's last proof run, k342, of its two units still banked: 0342-1, the fix for the wait-on-a-process-substitution race, and 0344-1, which runs a cut's remote legs after its local gates (k340 put 0334-2, 0341-1, 0340-1 and 0340-2 on devbin's main at 8f35cb72). Then devbin-vc's landing, hv's history rewrite and hv's cut of devbin 0.1.23, hv's brew steps, and devbin-vc's sweep into Intent's tree; cc gives the sweep a diff check for a packaging/homebrew change (hold 36). (2) dc's one Desk slot on rhadamanth, booked from devbin-vc's Desk after the sweep, every step one after the other and none beside a kovacs run (hv decision 45): (a) the WP-06 (c) to (e) proof on refs/bank/dc/0093-06/cde-draft-unproved-v3-on-fdd9fa2df rebased onto the sweep, its arms red then green and the bats suite at 24 jobs; (b) 0682's by-hand bin/devbin gate rust with TMPDIR on a 1.7G disk image; (c) dc banks, and vc lands WP-06 with 0682's Resolution and close; (d) bin/devbin release gates --leg kovacs; (e) the dry run, whose pre-flight runs no gate. Before (e): intentd on rhadamanth is stopped, and hv's answer is owed on who stops it, dc just before (e) or hv. It has to be down for (e) as for the cut: the pre-flight refuses a live intentd, a dry run stops at that step as the cut does and prints no step after it, and the cut's last step, brew smoke --at-tag, reinstalls brew's intent, the binary today's daemon runs (read by vc on 2026-11-12; sync --to-disk itself has run beside a daemon since issue 0500). Also before (e), vc calls a freeze: every seat commits its board, then nothing writes to Intent's tree until hv's cut has finished, not even a pickup, and vc confirms git status is empty. (3) At that HEAD, which vc sends to ic, ic reads that reference_current_check.sh exits 0 and that DIRT_SCOPE has not moved since 9500cb77a, the pair docs/known-defects.md was driven on at 52c251f0a; ic regenerates docs/reference only if a landing moved the register or ALL_VARIANTS. (4) hv's cut of v3.3.1 (hv decision 44); the macOS stage first runs in the cut, before the tag; hv starts intentd again at the end of releasing.md step 4; then vc tells agentic-engineering-vc it is installable. (5) Other projects' memory folders get ST0093 WP-01's prune when the plan rolls out to the estate.
